items.$comment: When a value is derived from claim events, receipts, payments or an immutable inventory record, artifact_ids must identify exact versioned dependencies in addition to evidence spans. Validate owner/subject and material dependency edges; absence cannot conceal an existing source event.

ClaimPartyV1.$comment: Insurer must match claimed contract; person IDs require owner; provider IDs are public exact branches. A TPA label is not authority to receive or settle; exact agreement/provenance is separately required.

ClaimDocumentationV1.$comment: IDs bind exact same-claim immutable requirement and receipt versions. Complete requires every applicable necessary requirement satisfied by accepted recipient/form evidence; empty requirements require explicit original-backed no-document obligation, not missing data. Last necessary receipt is derived from this exact set and retained as a dependency.

InventoryCountingProtocolV1.$comment: Candidate counts are never an approved denominator. Sealed measured inventory requires approved/adjudicated protocol, explicit duplicate-source and qualifier treatment, and membership/lineage closure independent of extraction.

InventorySourceManifestV1.$comment: Document IDs are unique and all documents are public acquired originals with matching hashes. Instance keys resolve to immutable identities in the separately reviewed quality store. Independent source occurrences must not be silently omitted during denominator adjudication.

BundleConsequenceV1.$comment: Explanation of a source-backed consequence only, never authorization or execution. Semantic validator requires contract_bundle scope, a public same-wrapper rule, valid exact component slots and resolved owned membership; missing membership yields unresolved. Does not create shared insured membership or pooled sum insured.

$comment: Closed JSON contracts for the staged CoverGuide database design through approved Batch 9.
